title: Ticwatch E
body: I purchased a Ticwatch E with Wear 2.0. It wasn't until after I tried setting up the watch when I scrolled down to see the Patching Watch Firmware and read there were "issues" with Wear 2.0 watches out of the box. My watch did pair with the Dexcom G5 however isn't working as a stand-alone collector (at least based on my attempts). I assume this is due to the same "bug".

comments.body:
i had the same issue but found a solution. i have updated the ticwatch to android 8.0 and now it works as a collector.  you can follow the thread here : 
https://forum.xda-developers.com/smartwatch/other-smartwatches/android-o-super-easy-ticwatch-e-s-t3789835
Sorry to interrupt but can anyone tell me which watch should I buy to use xdrip+. Was looking at ticwatch e or huewai 2?
Is this still valid? I am thinking of getting a ticwatch e and use it as standalone collector.
2 questions: If I don't want to use it as a stand alone connector, do I still need to do this? I just need the xdrip+ face to work. Also, will this link work with the Ticwatch Pro?

I just setup my ticwatch e with xdrip watchface and it works fine. Not the collector Mode, unfortunately, but with phone as master everything is fine. I use wearOS 2.15 something, and did all updates on the watch (should be android 8 oreo i think).

 Need to investigate how to make it run as a collector, propably will have to root it for that. Anything input on this is Welcome.

> i had the same issue but found a solution. i have updated the ticwatch to android 8.0 and now it works as a collector. you can follow the thread here :
> https://forum.xda-developers.com/smartwatch/other-smartwatches/android-o-super-easy-ticwatch-e-s-t3789835

Was anybody successful using the android 8.0 upgrade? I am also using a Ticwatch e and can't get the collector service running on it. Connection is always lost.

I don't think the watch works as a collector without a dedicated patch, as with almost every other smart watch besides SW3. I don't think that it has something to do with the Android version, as the ticwatch e can be officially patched to 8.0 without the hack mentioned above. The only way to use the ticwatch as a collector would be to ask an xdrip dev to write a dedicated ticwatch patch, afaik.

Edit: I patched my ticwatch e both with the official 8.0 update and the procedure mentioned above, but I did not get the collector service running, to answer your question. I ended up using a huawei watch 2...
Thank you very much @stackenblochen. I guess I have to exchange my watch as well. Using the watch as collector would be so much better.
